description: Set or clear the restock threshold (minimum stock) for a quantity-tracked item at ONE location — "alert us when Room 201 drops below 5". Thresholds are per item PER LOCATION, so locationId is REQUIRED alongside itemId: check_item_availability lists WHICH locations stock the item and every one of its distribution rows carries the locationId to pass here; search_resources (type: "location") is the way in for a location the item does not stock yet. Pass minStock as a number, or null to clear the threshold. "Low" is measured against AVAILABLE stock — what is on the shelf MINUS what is reserved for active orders — NOT the shelf count: 14 on hand with 10 reserved against a threshold of 5 IS low (4 available); check_item_availability reports exactly that verdict per level as isLow. When the location is low, a restock task opens for the order handlers; raising, lowering or clearing re-evaluates it immediately. Person-held stock cannot carry a threshold. Requires the manager role. Idempotent: repeating the same value changes nothing.

itemId.description: Item id (must be a quantity-tracked item)

locationId.description: Location resource id — read it off check_item_availability's distribution, or find it with search_resources

minStock.description: The threshold, or null to clear it

name: set_min_stock

minStock.description: The threshold now in force (absent = cleared)

quantity.description: Stock on hand at that location

title: Set restock threshold
